title: Took AI defect triage from proposal to funded plan
summary: My proposal for AI-assisted defect triage in Ultrasound was selected for funding, and I aligned stakeholders on a six-month engagement to deliver it.
what_would_have_happened: The funded idea would start without agreed scope, governance or architecture.
the_call: Agree scope, governance and architecture options before any build work starts.
what_i_did: Aligned stakeholders on scope, business-owned requirements, architecture and cost options, access needs and milestone governance, and shared templates from earlier projects.
what_changed: The initiative moved from proposal into a funded, scoped six-month engagement.
